name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task 'Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off' maps perfectly to a hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled). The machine implements this rule correctly. Since the task contains no unconditional goals, an empty FINAL_STATES is correct.

texts: Whenever the siren starts ringing, the agent must toggle the switch to stop it.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
